title: Overview of Illumina Sequencing by Synthesis Workflow | Standard SBS chemistry
summary: Illumina's 3D animation of its sequencing-by-synthesis workflow, from sample preparation and cluster generation to sequencing on a flow cell and data analysis.
why: Commenters call it the best visualization of how the most common DNA sequencers work, though it predates newer chemistry.

quote.text: is the best visualization of how the most popular type of DNA sequencer works (that I've found)
